summary: This is a routine 8-K filing reporting the termination of a material definitive agreement (the AIR Warrants) following full conversion of the underlying convertible note into common stock. The registrant, Momentus Inc., describes that all outstanding convertible indebtedness has been converted, leaving no further convertible debt. There are no special-situation elements such as a change of control, tender offer, going-private, activist campaign, or restructuring. The filing is a standard post-conversion administrative update and does not trigger a special-situations classification.
